title: How it’s going
lead: How much you log, how significant the results are and where your contribution goes. Everything is computed right in the browser from your entries — nothing leaves the device.
structure: What your contribution is made of

deltaSr.flat: no change vs the previous period

chart.navX: {chart}: use left and right arrows to step through values
chart.navY: {chart}: use up and down arrows to step through rows

timeline.title: Entries over time
timeline.partialNote: Faded columns are partial weeks or months at the edges of the period.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Share of the period’s entries; an entry can have several categories
categories.empty: Entries in this period have no categories.

rest.one: And {n} more category — see the table
rest.other: And {n} more categories — see the table

labels.title: Frequent labels
labels.subtitle: Share of the period’s entries
labels.empty: Entries in this period have no labels.

rest.one: And {n} more label — see the table
rest.other: And {n} more labels — see the table

highlights.title: Period highlights
highlights.noFacts: Not enough data for observations yet — they will appear as you add more entries.
highlights.note: Computed from your entries: plain arithmetic, no guessing, no AI.

observations.countUp: {change} more entries: {current} vs {previous} in the previous period.
observations.countDown: {change} fewer entries: {current} vs {previous} in the previous period.
observations.countSame: Same pace: {current} vs {previous} in the previous period.
observations.topCategory: Most of your contribution is in “{name}”: {count}, {share} of the period’s entries.
observations.strongestCategory: The most significant results are in “{name}”: average score {score} vs {overall} overall.
observations.quietStretch: {weeks} in a row with no entries: {range}.
observations.metricsUp: The share of entries with metrics grew from {from} to {to}.
observations.metricsDown: The share of entries with metrics dropped from {from} to {to}.
observations.evidenceUp: The share of entries linking to artifacts grew from {from} to {to}.
observations.evidenceDown: The share of entries linking to artifacts dropped from {from} to {to}.
observations.scoreUp: The average score went up from {from} to {to}.
observations.scoreDown: The average score went down from {from} to {to}.
observations.metricsTip: Only {share} of entries have a measurable outcome. Before → after numbers are the strongest argument in a review.

empty.title: Nothing to count yet
empty.text: Insights appear after your first entries: trends, scores, categories and the period’s highlights.

emptyPeriod.title: No entries in this period
emptyPeriod.text: Pick another period or add what you did during this time.

locked.title: Advanced analytics
locked.text: Available on the extended plan. Basic stats and trends stay with you on any plan.

features.highlights: most significant entries and observations for the period
